fact: Data.FI, funded by PEPFAR through USAID under an agreement ending 14 December 2025, says that in October 2023 to March 2024 it supported system development for the MOH-led CMIS, in use at 75% (247 of 327) of healthcare facilities, and that the Chief of the Ministry's Strategic Information Department mandated that all facilities use CMIS as their primary data collection system.
title: Data.FI Semi-Annual Performance Report 2024, October 2023–March 2024
